candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs fail with 502 after ~2s because client calls to the order service time out (transport errors), indicating order-service unavailability or latency exceeding the gateway timeout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics absent; cannot distinguish order crash, saturation, or its own downstream (inventory/payment/postgresql) latency.

report.explanation: All 8 checkout requests return 502 at ~2s, and gateway logs show transport errors on POST /v1/orders to the order service, while /readyz stays 200. This localizes the fault to the order dependency, but order-side evidence is needed to pin the specific mechanism.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for /v1/orders during the incident window
Order-to-inventory/payment/postgresql dependency latency and error metrics
Gateway client timeout configuration to confirm the ~2s cutoff
